tools.name: natal_chart
tools.description: Cast a tropical natal chart. Returns each planet with its sign, degree, retrograde flag, and whole-sign house, plus the ascendant, midheaven, twelve houses, and major aspects. Without a birth time the rising sign and houses are omitted. Example: birth_date 1990-07-04, birth_time 14:30, latitude 40.7

tools.name: transits
tools.description: Current planets in the sky and their major aspects to a natal chart. Pass the same birth fields as natal_chart. date is an optional YYYY-MM-DD; omit it for the sky right now. A date is read at 12:00 in the birth timezone.

tools.name: sun_moon_rising
tools.description: Sun sign, Moon sign, and rising sign for a birth date and place. The rising sign is omitted when birth_time is omitted. If the Moon changes sign that day and the time is unknown, both signs are returned.
